title: Admin invite token is left in the URL and browser history after load
source: public admin invite URL query parameter invite
control: consumeAdminInviteHint reads invite but never deletes it
sink: browser address bar / history retain bearer token
evidence: compare with oauthRedirectTo/passwordRecoveryRedirectTo which scrub secret-bearing query params

buildAdminInviteUrl sets ?invite=token, consumeAdminInviteHint only reads and trims the value, and initializeApp never calls history.replaceState to remove invite; password/OAuth flows do scrub sensitive params

control: missing URL scrubbing after token consumption
